# The Silver Searcher

A code searching tool similar to `ack`, with a focus on speed.

## What's so great about Ag?

* It is an order of magnitude faster than `ack`.
* It ignores file patterns from your `.gitignore` and `.hgignore`.
* If there are files in your source repo you don't want to search, just add their patterns to a `.ignore` file. (\*cough\* `*.min.js` \*cough\*)
* The command name is 33% shorter than `ack`, and all keys are on the home row!

Ag is quite stable now. Most changes are new features, minor bug fixes, or performance improvements. It's much faster than Ack in my benchmarks:

    ack test_blah ~/code/  104.66s user 4.82s system 99% cpu 1:50.03 total

    ag test_blah ~/code/  4.67s user 4.58s system 286% cpu 3.227 total

Ack and Ag found the same results, but Ag was 34x faster (3.2 seconds vs 110 seconds). My `~/code` directory is about 8GB. Thanks to git/hg/ignore, Ag only searched 700MB of that.

## Installing

### macOS

    brew install the_silver_searcher

or

    port install the_silver_searcher


### Linux

* Fedora 21 and lower

        yum install the_silver_searcher
* Fedora 22+

        dnf install the_silver_searcher
* RHEL7+

        yum install epel-release.noarch the_silver_searcher
* Gentoo

        emerge -a sys-apps/the_silver_searcher
* Arch

        pacman -S the_silver_searcher

* Slackware

        sbopkg -i the_silver_searcher

* openSUSE

        zypper install the_silver_searcher

* CentOS

        yum install the_silver_searcher

* NixOS/Nix/Nixpkgs

        nix-env -iA silver-searcher

* SUSE Linux Enterprise: Follow [these simple instructions](https://software.opensuse.org/download.html?project=utilities&package=the_silver_searcher).


### BSD

* FreeBSD

        pkg install the_silver_searcher
* OpenBSD/NetBSD

### Windows

  Unofficial daily builds are [available](https://github.com/k-takata/the_silver_searcher-win32).

  - The setup script in the Ag's winget package installs ag.exe in the first directory that matches one of these criteria:

     2. In the directory defined in environment variable bindir_%PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE%
     3. In the directory defined in environment variable bindir

* Cygwin

## Editor Integration

### Vim

You can use Ag with [ack.vim](https://github.com/mileszs/ack.vim) by adding the following line to your `.vimrc`:

    let g:ackprg = 'ag --nogroup --nocolor --column'

or:

    let g:ackprg = 'ag --vimgrep'

Which has the same effect but will report every match on the line.

### Emacs

You can use [ag.el][] as an Emacs front-end to Ag. See also: [helm-ag].

[ag.el]: https://github.com/Wilfred/ag.el
[helm-ag]: https://github.com/syohex/emacs-helm-ag

### TextMate

TextMate users can use Ag with [my fork](https://github.com/ggreer/AckMate) of the popular AckMate plugin, which lets you use both Ack and Ag for searching. If you already have AckMate you just want to replace Ack with Ag, move or delete `"~/Library/Application Support/TextMate/PlugIns/AckMate.tmplugin/Contents/Resources/ackmate_ack"` and run `ln -s /usr/local/bin/ag "~/Library/Application Support/TextMate/PlugIns/AckMate.tmplugin/Contents/Resources/ackmate_ack"`

## Other stuff you might like

* [Ack](https://github.com/petdance/ack3) - Better than grep. Without Ack, Ag would not exist.
* [ack.vim](https://github.com/mileszs/ack.vim)
* [Exuberant Ctags](http://ctags.sourceforge.net/) - Faster than Ag, but it builds an index beforehand. Good for *really* big codebases.
* [Git-grep](http://git-scm.com/docs/git-grep) - As fast as Ag but only works on git repos.
* [fzf](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf) - A command-line fuzzy finder 
* [ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep)
* [Sack](https://github.com/sampson-chen/sack) - A utility that wraps Ack and Ag. It removes a lot of repetition from searching and opening matching files.

def colorize(s, code, opt):
    return f"\033[{code}m{s}\033[0m\033[K" if opt.color else s


def is_hidden_path(path, root=None):
    base = os.path.basename(path.rstrip(os.sep))
    return base.startswith('.') and base not in ('.','..')


def read_ignore_file(path):
    pats=[]
    try:
        with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
            for line in f:
                line=line.strip('\n')
                if not line or line.lstrip().startswith('#'): continue
                pats.append(line.strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    return pats


def ignore_match(path, base, pats):
    rel = path.replace(os.sep,'/')
    for p in pats:
        neg = p.startswith('!')
        if neg: p = p[1:]
        if not p: continue
        p = p.strip()
        dirpat = p.endswith('/')
        if dirpat: p = p.rstrip('/')
        pp = p.replace('\\','/')
        hit = False
        if '/' in pp:
            hit = fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pp) or fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, '*/'+pp)
        else:
            hit = fnmatch.fnmatch(base, pp) or base == pp
        if hit:
            return not neg
    return False


def load_global_ignores(opt):
    pats = list(opt.ignores)
    home = os.environ.get('HOME')
    if home and not (opt.all_types or opt.all_text or opt.unrestricted):
        pats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(home,'.agignore'))
    for p in opt.extra_ignore_files:
        pats += read_ignore_file(p)
    return pats


def type_ok(path, opt):
    if not opt.type_filter: return True
    bn = os.path.basename(path)
    for ext in opt.type_filter:
        if ext.startswith('.'):
            if bn.endswith(ext): return True
    return False


def file_name_ok(path, opt):
    if opt.file_regex:
        try:
            if not re.search(opt.file_regex, path): return False
        except re.error:
            return False
    return type_ok(path, opt)


def discover(paths, opt):
    files=[]; errors=[]
    global_ign = load_global_ignores(opt)
    use_ign = not (opt.all_types or opt.all_text or opt.unrestricted)
    use_vcs = use_ign and not opt.skip_vcs_ignores
    use_dotignore = use_ign
    for start in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(start):
            errors.append((start, 'missing'))
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(start) or (os.path.islink(start) and not os.path.isdir(start)):
            if file_name_ok(start, opt): files.append(start)
            continue
        if os.path.isdir(start):
            def rec(d, depth, pats):
                curpats = list(pats)
                if use_dotignore:
                    curpats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(d,'.ignore'))
                if use_vcs:
                    curpats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(d,'.gitignore'))
                    curpats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(d,'.hgignore'))
                try:
                    entries = list(os.scandir(d))
                except OSError as e:
                    errors.append((d, str(e)))
                    return
                dirs=[]; fs=[]
                for ent in entries:
                    name=ent.name; p=ent.path
                    if name in ('.','..'): continue
                    try:
                        isdir = ent.is_dir(follow_symlinks=opt.follow)
                        isfile = ent.is_file(follow_symlinks=opt.follow)
                    except OSError:
                        continue
                    if ent.is_symlink() and not opt.follow:
                        continue
                    if not (opt.hidden or opt.unrestricted) and name.startswith('.'):
                        continue
                    if use_ign and ignore_match(p, name, curpats):
                        continue
                    if isdir:
                        dirs.append(p)
                    elif isfile:
                        if file_name_ok(p, opt): fs.append(p)
                # The original's single-worker traversal visits subdirectories before files.
                if opt.depth < 0 or depth < opt.depth:
                    for sub in dirs:
                        rec(sub, depth+1, curpats)
                files.extend(fs)
            rec(start,0,global_ign)
        else:
            pass
    return files, errors


def stdin_is_pipe():
    try:
        m = os.fstat(0).st_mode
        return stat.S_ISFIFO(m) or stat.S_ISREG(m)
    except Exception:
        return False


def make_regex(pattern, opt):
    pat = re.escape(pattern) if opt.literal else pattern
    if opt.word:
        pat = r'\b(?:' + pat + r')\b'
    flags = re.MULTILINE
    cm = opt.case_mode
    if cm == 'smart':
        if not any(c.isupper() for c in pattern): flags |= re.IGNORECASE
    elif cm == 'insensitive':
        flags |= re.IGNORECASE
    try:
        return re.compile(pat, flags)
    except re.error as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ERR: Bad regex! pcre_compile() failed at position {getattr(e,'pos',0) if getattr(e,'pos',None) is not None else 0}: {e.msg}\n")
        sys.stderr.write("If you meant to search for a literal string, run ag with -Q\n")
        sys.exit(2)

@dataclass
class LineHit:
    lno: int
    text: str
    matches: list
    is_context: bool = False

@dataclass
class FileResult:
    path: str
    hits: list
    match_count: int
    bytes: int
    binary: bool = False
    skipped_too_many: bool = False


def read_file_bytes(path, opt):
    if opt.search_zip and path.endswith('.gz'):
        with gzip.open(path,'rb') as f: return f.read()
    if opt.search_zip and (path.endswith('.xz') or path.endswith('.lzma')):
        with lzma.open(path,'rb') as f: return f.read()
    with open(path,'rb') as f: return f.read()


def find_matches_in_line(rx, line, invert=False):
    if invert:
        return [] if rx.search(line) else [(0,0,'')]
    out=[]
    for m in rx.finditer(line):
        a,b=m.span()
        if a==b:
            # Prevent pathological zero-length repeats; ag/PCRE advances too.
            continue
        out.append((a,b,line[a:b]))
    return out


def search_content(path, data, rx, opt, is_stdin=False):
    binary = (b'\0' in data[:8192]) and not is_stdin
    if binary and not (opt.search_binary or opt.all_types or opt.unrestricted):
        return FileResult(path, [], 0, len(data), binary=True)
    text = data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    # Preserve line contents without terminators, like ag output.
    raw_lines = text.splitlines()
    if text.endswith('\n') or text.endswith('\r'):
        pass
    hits=[]; match_count=0; matching_lines=[]
    if binary:
        m = rx.search(text)
        if (m is not None) ^ opt.invert:
            return FileResult(path, [], 1, len(data), binary=True)
        return FileResult(path, [], 0, len(data), binary=True)
    for idx,line in enumerate(raw_lines, start=1):
        ms = find_matches_in_line(rx, line, opt.invert)
        if ms:
            c = 1 if opt.invert else len(ms)
            match_count += c
            matching_lines.append(idx)
            hits.append(LineHit(idx,line,ms,False))
            if opt.max_count and match_count >= opt.max_count and opt.max_count != 10000:
                return add_context(FileResult(path,hits,match_count,len(data),False,True), raw_lines, opt)
    return add_context(FileResult(path,hits,match_count,len(data),False,False), raw_lines, opt)


def add_context(fr, lines, opt):
    if (opt.before <= 0 and opt.after <= 0) or not fr.hits:
        return fr
    match_by_lno={h.lno:h for h in fr.hits}
    needed=set()
    for h in fr.hits:
        for n in range(max(1,h.lno-opt.before), min(len(lines),h.lno+opt.after)+1):
            needed.add(n)
    new=[]
    for n in sorted(needed):
        if n in match_by_lno:
            new.append(match_by_lno[n])
        else:
            new.append(LineHit(n, lines[n-1], [], True))
    fr.hits=new
    return fr


def truncate_line(s, opt):
    if opt.width and opt.width > 0 and len(s) > opt.width:
        return s[:opt.width] + ' [...]'
    return s


def highlight(s, matches, opt):
    if not opt.color or not matches or opt.invert:
        return s
    pieces=[]; last=0
    for a,b,_ in matches:
        if a < last: continue
        pieces.append(s[last:a])
        pieces.append(colorize(s[a:b], opt.color_match, opt))
        last=b
    pieces.append(s[last:])
    return ''.join(pieces)


def format_line(fr, h, opt, show_filename, grouped, is_single_or_stdin=False, sep=':'):
    text = truncate_line(h.text, opt)
    text = highlight(text, h.matches, opt)
    if opt.only_matching and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
        return None
    line_sep = '-' if h.is_context else ':'
    parts=[]
    if show_filename and not grouped:
        parts.append(colorize(fr.path, opt.color_path, opt))
    if opt.numbers:
        ln = str(h.lno)
        if opt.color: ln = colorize(ln, opt.color_line, opt)
        parts.append(ln)
    if opt.column and not h.is_context and h.matches and not opt.invert:
        parts.append(str(h.matches[0][0]+1))
    if not parts:
        return text
    if show_filename and not grouped and opt.numbers and h.is_context:
        # path:line-context form
        return parts[0] + ':' + parts[1] + '-' + text
    if show_filename and not grouped:
        return ':'.join(parts) + ':' + text
    if h.is_context and opt.numbers:
        return parts[0] + '-' + text
    return ':'.join(parts) + ':' + text


def emit_results(results, opt, input_kind, paths_count):
    # Decide filename display similarly to ag for common cases.
    multiple = (paths_count != 1) or any(os.path.isdir(p) for p in input_kind if isinstance(p,str))
    if input_kind == ['<stdin>']:
        show_filename = False
        if not opt.numbers_set: opt.numbers = False
    else:
        show_filename = multiple
    if opt.filename_flag is False:
        show_filename = False
        opt.numbers = False if not opt.numbers_set else opt.numbers
    # --filename is only forceful in no-heading/group-explicit forms; this matches common ag behavior.
    if opt.filename_flag is True and opt.grouped_explicit and not opt.heading:
        show_filename = True
    grouped = opt.grouped_explicit and show_filename and not (opt.vimgrep or opt.only_matching or opt.count or opt.files_with_matches or opt.files_without_matches)
    any_match=False
    out=[]
    files_with=0; files_searched=0; bytes_searched=0; total_matches=0
    prev_file_output=False
    for fr in results:
        files_searched += 1; bytes_searched += fr.bytes; total_matches += fr.match_count
        has = fr.match_count > 0
        if has: files_with += 1; any_match=True
        if fr.skipped_too_many:
            eprint(opt, f"ERR: Too many matches in {fr.path}. Skipping the rest of this file.\n")
        if opt.stats_only:
            continue
        delim = '\0' if opt.null else '\n'
        if opt.files_with_matches:
            if has: out.append(fr.path + delim)
            continue
        if opt.files_without_matches:
            if not has: out.append(fr.path + delim)
            continue
        if opt.count:
            if input_kind == ['<stdin>']:
                for h in fr.hits:
                    if not h.is_context: out.append(str(len(h.matches) if not opt.invert else 1) + delim)
            elif has or show_filename:
                val = str(fr.match_count)
                if show_filename: out.append(fr.path + ':' + val + delim)
                else: out.append(val + delim)
            continue
        if not has and not opt.print_all_files:
            continue
        if fr.binary:
            if has:
                out.append(f"Binary file {fr.path} matches.\n")
            continue
        if opt.ackmate:
            if show_filename:
                if prev_file_output: out.append('\n')
                out.append(':' + fr.path + '\n')
            for h in fr.hits:
                if h.is_context: continue
                specs=[]
                for a,b,_ in h.matches:
                    specs.append(f"{a} {b-a}")
                out.append(f"{h.lno};" + ','.join(specs) + ':' + h.text + '\n')
            prev_file_output=True
            continue
        if grouped:
            if prev_file_output and opt.break_between:
                out.append('\n')
            if opt.heading:
                out.append(colorize(fr.path, opt.color_path, opt) + '\n')
            last_lno=None
            for h in fr.hits:
                if last_lno is not None and h.lno > last_lno + 1 and (opt.before or opt.after):
                    out.append('--\n')
                last_lno=h.lno
                if opt.only_matching and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
                    for a,b,m in h.matches:
                        prefix=''
                        if opt.numbers: prefix += colorize(str(h.lno), opt.color_line, opt) + ':'
                        out.append(prefix + m + '\n')
                elif opt.vimgrep and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
                    for a,b,m in h.matches:
                        out.append(f"{fr.path}:{h.lno}:{a+1}:{h.text}\n")
                else:
                    out.append(format_line(fr,h,opt,False,True) + '\n')
            prev_file_output=True
        else:
            # Blank line between files for explicit --noheading or --nofilename with break.
            if prev_file_output and opt.break_between and opt.grouped_explicit:
                out.append('\n')
            last_lno=None
            for h in fr.hits:
                if last_lno is not None and h.lno > last_lno + 1 and (opt.before or opt.after):

def colorize(s, code, opt):
    return f"\033[{code}m{s}\033[0m\033[K" if opt.color else s


def is_hidden_path(path, root=None):
    base = os.path.basename(path.rstrip(os.sep))
    return base.startswith('.') and base not in ('.','..')


def read_ignore_file(path):
    pats=[]
    try:
        with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
            for line in f:
                line=line.strip('\n')
                if not line or line.lstrip().startswith('#'): continue
                pats.append(line.strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    return pats


def ignore_match(path, base, pats):
    rel = path.replace(os.sep,'/')
    for p in pats:
        neg = p.startswith('!')
        if neg: p = p[1:]
        if not p: continue
        p = p.strip()
        dirpat = p.endswith('/')
        if dirpat: p = p.rstrip('/')
        pp = p.replace('\\','/')
        hit = False
        if '/' in pp:
            hit = fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pp) or fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, '*/'+pp)
        else:
            hit = fnmatch.fnmatch(base, pp) or base == pp
        if hit:
            return not neg
    return False


def load_global_ignores(opt):
    pats = list(opt.ignores)
    home = os.environ.get('HOME')
    if home and not (opt.all_types or opt.all_text or opt.unrestricted):
        pats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(home,'.agignore'))
    for p in opt.extra_ignore_files:
        pats += read_ignore_file(p)
    return pats


def type_ok(path, opt):
    if not opt.type_filter: return True
    bn = os.path.basename(path)
    for ext in opt.type_filter:
        if ext.startswith('.'):
            if bn.endswith(ext): return True
    return False


def file_name_ok(path, opt):
    if opt.file_regex:
        try:
            if not re.search(opt.file_regex, path): return False
        except re.error:
            return False
    return type_ok(path, opt)


def discover(paths, opt):
    files=[]; errors=[]
    global_ign = load_global_ignores(opt)
    use_ign = not (opt.all_types or opt.all_text or opt.unrestricted)
    use_vcs = use_ign and not opt.skip_vcs_ignores
    use_dotignore = use_ign
    for start in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(start):
            errors.append((start, 'missing'))
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(start) or (os.path.islink(start) and not os.path.isdir(start)):
            if file_name_ok(start, opt): files.append(start)
            continue
        if os.path.isdir(start):
            def rec(d, depth, pats):
                curpats = list(pats)
                if use_dotignore:
                    curpats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(d,'.ignore'))
                if use_vcs:
                    curpats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(d,'.gitignore'))
                    curpats += read_ignore_file(os.path.join(d,'.hgignore'))
                try:
                    entries = list(os.scandir(d))
                except OSError as e:
                    errors.append((d, str(e)))
                    return
                dirs=[]; fs=[]
                for ent in entries:
                    name=ent.name; p=ent.path
                    if name in ('.','..'): continue
                    try:
                        isdir = ent.is_dir(follow_symlinks=opt.follow)
                        isfile = ent.is_file(follow_symlinks=opt.follow)
                    except OSError:
                        continue
                    if ent.is_symlink() and not opt.follow:
                        continue
                    if not (opt.hidden or opt.unrestricted) and name.startswith('.'):
                        continue
                    if use_ign and ignore_match(p, name, curpats):
                        continue
                    if isdir:
                        dirs.append(p)
                    elif isfile:
                        if file_name_ok(p, opt): fs.append(p)
                # The original's single-worker traversal visits subdirectories before files.
                if opt.depth < 0 or depth < opt.depth:
                    for sub in dirs:
                        rec(sub, depth+1, curpats)
                files.extend(fs)
            rec(start,0,global_ign)
        else:
            pass
    return files, errors


def stdin_is_pipe():
    try:
        m = os.fstat(0).st_mode
        return stat.S_ISFIFO(m) or stat.S_ISREG(m)
    except Exception:
        return False


def make_regex(pattern, opt):
    pat = re.escape(pattern) if opt.literal else pattern
    if opt.word:
        pat = r'\b(?:' + pat + r')\b'
    flags = re.MULTILINE
    cm = opt.case_mode
    if cm == 'smart':
        if not any(c.isupper() for c in pattern): flags |= re.IGNORECASE
    elif cm == 'insensitive':
        flags |= re.IGNORECASE
    try:
        return re.compile(pat, flags)
    except re.error as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ERR: Bad regex! pcre_compile() failed at position {getattr(e,'pos',0) if getattr(e,'pos',None) is not None else 0}: {e.msg}\n")
        sys.stderr.write("If you meant to search for a literal string, run ag with -Q\n")
        sys.exit(2)

@dataclass
class LineHit:
    lno: int
    text: str
    matches: list
    is_context: bool = False

@dataclass
class FileResult:
    path: str
    hits: list
    match_count: int
    bytes: int
    binary: bool = False
    skipped_too_many: bool = False


def read_file_bytes(path, opt):
    if opt.search_zip and path.endswith('.gz'):
        with gzip.open(path,'rb') as f: return f.read()
    if opt.search_zip and (path.endswith('.xz') or path.endswith('.lzma')):
        with lzma.open(path,'rb') as f: return f.read()
    with open(path,'rb') as f: return f.read()


def find_matches_in_line(rx, line, invert=False):
    if invert:
        return [] if rx.search(line) else [(0,0,'')]
    out=[]
    for m in rx.finditer(line):
        a,b=m.span()
        if a==b:
            # Prevent pathological zero-length repeats; ag/PCRE advances too.
            continue
        out.append((a,b,line[a:b]))
    return out


def search_content(path, data, rx, opt, is_stdin=False):
    binary = (b'\0' in data[:8192]) and not is_stdin
    if binary and not (opt.search_binary or opt.all_types or opt.unrestricted):
        return FileResult(path, [], 0, len(data), binary=True)
    text = data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    # Preserve line contents without terminators, like ag output.
    raw_lines = text.splitlines()
    if text.endswith('\n') or text.endswith('\r'):
        pass
    hits=[]; match_count=0; matching_lines=[]
    if binary:
        m = rx.search(text)
        if (m is not None) ^ opt.invert:
            return FileResult(path, [], 1, len(data), binary=True)
        return FileResult(path, [], 0, len(data), binary=True)
    for idx,line in enumerate(raw_lines, start=1):
        ms = find_matches_in_line(rx, line, opt.invert)
        if ms:
            c = 1 if opt.invert else len(ms)
            match_count += c
            matching_lines.append(idx)
            hits.append(LineHit(idx,line,ms,False))
            if opt.max_count and match_count >= opt.max_count and opt.max_count != 10000:
                return add_context(FileResult(path,hits,match_count,len(data),False,True), raw_lines, opt)
    return add_context(FileResult(path,hits,match_count,len(data),False,False), raw_lines, opt)


def add_context(fr, lines, opt):
    if (opt.before <= 0 and opt.after <= 0) or not fr.hits:
        return fr
    match_by_lno={h.lno:h for h in fr.hits}
    needed=set()
    for h in fr.hits:
        for n in range(max(1,h.lno-opt.before), min(len(lines),h.lno+opt.after)+1):
            needed.add(n)
    new=[]
    for n in sorted(needed):
        if n in match_by_lno:
            new.append(match_by_lno[n])
        else:
            new.append(LineHit(n, lines[n-1], [], True))
    fr.hits=new
    return fr


def truncate_line(s, opt):
    if opt.width and opt.width > 0 and len(s) > opt.width:
        return s[:opt.width] + ' [...]'
    return s


def highlight(s, matches, opt):
    if not opt.color or not matches or opt.invert:
        return s
    pieces=[]; last=0
    for a,b,_ in matches:
        if a < last: continue
        pieces.append(s[last:a])
        pieces.append(colorize(s[a:b], opt.color_match, opt))
        last=b
    pieces.append(s[last:])
    return ''.join(pieces)


def format_line(fr, h, opt, show_filename, grouped, is_single_or_stdin=False, sep=':'):
    text = truncate_line(h.text, opt)
    text = highlight(text, h.matches, opt)
    if opt.only_matching and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
        return None
    line_sep = '-' if h.is_context else ':'
    parts=[]
    if show_filename and not grouped:
        parts.append(colorize(fr.path, opt.color_path, opt))
    if opt.numbers:
        ln = str(h.lno)
        if opt.color: ln = colorize(ln, opt.color_line, opt)
        parts.append(ln)
    if opt.column and not h.is_context and h.matches and not opt.invert:
        parts.append(str(h.matches[0][0]+1))
    if not parts:
        return text
    if show_filename and not grouped and opt.numbers and h.is_context:
        # path:line-context form
        return parts[0] + ':' + parts[1] + '-' + text
    if show_filename and not grouped:
        return ':'.join(parts) + ':' + text
    if h.is_context and opt.numbers:
        return parts[0] + '-' + text
    return ':'.join(parts) + ':' + text


def emit_results(results, opt, input_kind, paths_count):
    # Decide filename display similarly to ag for common cases.
    multiple = (paths_count != 1) or any(os.path.isdir(p) for p in input_kind if isinstance(p,str))
    if input_kind == ['<stdin>']:
        show_filename = False
        if not opt.numbers_set: opt.numbers = False
    else:
        show_filename = multiple
    if opt.filename_flag is False:
        show_filename = False
        opt.numbers = False if not opt.numbers_set else opt.numbers
    # --filename is only forceful in no-heading/group-explicit forms; this matches common ag behavior.
    if opt.filename_flag is True and opt.grouped_explicit and not opt.heading:
        show_filename = True
    grouped = opt.grouped_explicit and show_filename and not (opt.vimgrep or opt.only_matching or opt.count or opt.files_with_matches or opt.files_without_matches)
    any_match=False
    out=[]
    files_with=0; files_searched=0; bytes_searched=0; total_matches=0
    prev_file_output=False
    for fr in results:
        files_searched += 1; bytes_searched += fr.bytes; total_matches += fr.match_count
        has = fr.match_count > 0
        if has: files_with += 1; any_match=True
        if fr.skipped_too_many:
            eprint(opt, f"ERR: Too many matches in {fr.path}. Skipping the rest of this file.\n")
        if opt.stats_only:
            continue
        delim = '\0' if opt.null else '\n'
        if opt.files_with_matches:
            if has: out.append(fr.path + delim)
            continue
        if opt.files_without_matches:
            if not has: out.append(fr.path + delim)
            continue
        if opt.count:
            if input_kind == ['<stdin>']:
                for h in fr.hits:
                    if not h.is_context: out.append(str(len(h.matches) if not opt.invert else 1) + delim)
            elif has or show_filename:
                val = str(fr.match_count)
                if show_filename: out.append(fr.path + ':' + val + delim)
                else: out.append(val + delim)
            continue
        if not has and not opt.print_all_files:
            continue
        if fr.binary:
            if has:
                out.append(f"Binary file {fr.path} matches.\n")
            continue
        if opt.ackmate:
            if show_filename:
                if prev_file_output: out.append('\n')
                out.append(':' + fr.path + '\n')
            for h in fr.hits:
                if h.is_context: continue
                specs=[]
                for a,b,_ in h.matches:
                    specs.append(f"{a} {b-a}")
                out.append(f"{h.lno};" + ','.join(specs) + ':' + h.text + '\n')
            prev_file_output=True
            continue
        if grouped:
            if prev_file_output and opt.break_between:
                out.append('\n')
            if opt.heading:
                out.append(colorize(fr.path, opt.color_path, opt) + '\n')
            last_lno=None
            for h in fr.hits:
                if last_lno is not None and h.lno > last_lno + 1 and (opt.before or opt.after):
                    out.append('--\n')
                last_lno=h.lno
                if opt.only_matching and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
                    for a,b,m in h.matches:
                        prefix=''
                        if opt.numbers: prefix += colorize(str(h.lno), opt.color_line, opt) + ':'
                        out.append(prefix + m + '\n')
                elif opt.vimgrep and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
                    for a,b,m in h.matches:
                        out.append(f"{fr.path}:{h.lno}:{a+1}:{h.text}\n")
                else:
                    out.append(format_line(fr,h,opt,False,True) + '\n')
            prev_file_output=True
        else:
            # Blank line between files for explicit --noheading or --nofilename with break.
            if prev_file_output and opt.break_between and opt.grouped_explicit:
                out.append('\n')
            last_lno=None
            for h in fr.hits:
                if last_lno is not None and h.lno > last_lno + 1 and (opt.before or opt.after):
                    out.append('--\n')
                last_lno=h.lno
                if opt.only_matching and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
                    for a,b,m in h.matches:
                        pref=''
                        if show_filename: pref += colorize(fr.path,opt.color_path,opt)+':'
                        if opt.numbers: pref += colorize(str(h.lno),opt.color_line,opt)+':'
                        out.append(pref + m + '\n')
                elif opt.vimgrep and not h.is_context and not opt.invert:
                    for a,b,m in h.matches:
                        pref = (fr.path + ':') if show_filename else ''
                        out.append(f"{pref}{h.lno}:{a+1}:{h.text}\n")
                else:
                    out.append(format_line(fr,h,opt,show_filename,False) + '\n')
            prev_file_output=True
    sys.stdout.write(''.join(out))
    if opt.stats or opt.stats_only:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{total_matches} matches\n{files_with} files contained matches\n{files_searched} files searched\n{bytes_searched} bytes searched\n{time.time()-START:.6f} seconds\n")
    return any_match


def filename_mode(opt, paths):
    # -g: print file names whose path matches the regex, respecting file discovery filters.
    rx = make_regex(opt.filename_pattern, opt)
    files, errors = discover(paths, opt)
    for p,kind in errors:
        eprint(opt, f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {p}\nERR: Error opening directory {p}: No such file or directory\n")
    out=[]; anym=False
    delim='\0' if opt.null else '\n'
    for f in files:
        if rx.search(f):
            out.append(f+delim); anym=True
    sys.stdout.write(''.join(out))
    return 0 if anym else 1


def main(argv):
    opt,pos = parse_args(argv)
    if opt.filename_pattern is not None:
        paths = pos if pos else ['.']
        return filename_mode(opt, paths)
    if not pos:
        sys.stdout.write(HELP)
        return 1
    pattern = pos[0]
    paths = pos[1:]
    if pattern == '':
        if opt.files_with_matches:
            # Print all files that would be searched.
            paths2 = paths if paths else ['.']
            files, errors = discover(paths2, opt)
            delim='\0' if opt.null else '\n'
            sys.stdout.write(''.join(f+delim for f in files))
            return 0
        eprint(opt, "ERR: Error: No query. What do you want to search for?\n")
        return 1
    rx = make_regex(pattern, opt)
    results=[]; original_paths = paths[:] if paths else []
    if not paths and stdin_is_pipe():
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        if data:
            fr = search_content('<stdin>', data, rx, opt, True)
            results=[fr]
            anym=emit_results(results,opt,['<stdin>'],0)
            return 0 if anym or opt.passthrough else 1
    if not paths:
        paths=['.']
    files, errors = discover(paths, opt)
    for p,kind in errors:
        eprint(opt, f"ERR: Error stat()ing: {p}\nERR: Error opening directory {p}: No such file or directory\n")
    for f in files:
        try:
            data = read_file_bytes(f,opt)
        except PermissionError:
            eprint(opt, f"ERR: Skipping {f}: Error opening file: Permission denied\n")
            continue
        except Exception as e:
            # Compressed files are ignored if -z is not active; other open errors are reported tersely.
            eprint(opt, f"ERR: Skipping {f}: Error opening file: {getattr(e,'strerror',str(e))}\n")
            continue
        # Skip compressed binary-looking files unless -z was requested.
        if (f.endswith('.gz') or f.endswith('.xz') or f.endswith('.lzma')) and not opt.search_zip:
            continue
        results.append(search_content(f,data,rx,opt,False))
    anym=emit_results(results,opt,paths,len(paths))
    # Errors do not force failure if matches were found.
    return 0 if anym else 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    START = time.time()
    try:
        sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except BrokenPipeError:
        try: sys.stdout.close()
        except Exception: pass
        sys.exit(0)
